visual_summary: A small robot confronts a much larger, heavily armed robot inside a cluttered metallic interior. The large robot threatens to trigger its self-destruct system, but the smaller robot reveals it has already taken control of the larger robot's programming. The larger robot panics, declares that robots without a human master have no reason to exist, and then violently throws itself into a wall, breaking apart. The page ends with debris and wreckage scattered across the floor while the smaller robot remains intact.
